BETA Close X Drax Group plc has executed a share buyback, purchasing 74,500 ordinary shares on March 30, 2026, at prices ranging from 859.50p to 870.50p, with a volume-weighted average price of 865.98p. Following this transaction, Drax Group has 432,461,089 ordinary shares in issue, with 95,954,615 held in treasury, resulting in 336,506,474 voting rights. Since the buyback program began on July 31, 2025, a total of 8,861,803 shares have been repurchased. Disclaimer* Drax Group PLC 31 March 2026 31 March 2026 Drax Group plc Transactions in own shares Drax Group plc (Drax Group) announces that, in accordance with the terms of its share buyback programme (the "Programme") announced on 31 July 2025, it has purchased the following number of its ordinary shares of 11 16/29 pence each (Ordinary Shares) on the London Stock Exchange through J.P. Morgan Securities plc. Date of purchase: 30 March 2026 Number of ordinary shares purchased: 74,500 Lowest price paid per ordinary share (p): 859.5000 Highest price paid per ordinary share (p): 870.5000 Volume weighted average price paid per share (p): 865.9805 Following the above transaction, Drax Group will have 432,461,089 Ordinary Shares in issue, including treasury shares. The total number of Ordinary Shares held in treasury is 95,954,615. The total number of voting rights in Drax Group, excluding treasury shares as at 30 March 2026 is 336,506,474. This figure may be used by shareholders (and others with notification obligations) as the denominator for the calculations by which they will determine if they are required to notify their interest in, or a change to their interest in, Drax Group under the FCA's Disclosure and Transparency Rules. Since the announcement of the Programme on 31 July 2025, Drax Group has purchased 8,861,803 Ordinary Shares in aggregate for treasury.
